notice: Phase 1 uses deterministic adapters only. The four action tiers classify behaviour; no AI surface may publish, spend, send, trade, change a price or place an order. Evaluation gates are requirements, not completed evidence.

tierSemantics.read_only: Returns information with no persisted or external side effect.
tierSemantics.recommendation: Suggests products or actions; the user or a named human decides.
tierSemantics.draft: Creates a reviewable artefact that is not externally visible until a distinct human approves it.
tierSemantics.execution: An external or state-changing effect such as publish, spend, send, price change or order. Always blocked in the prototype.

confirmationGates.purchase: Explicit user confirmation and a deterministic service; the AI may never place an order.
confirmationGates.marketingSpend: Named human approval and marketing release gate; autonomous spend is disabled.
confirmationGates.pricing: Named seller or Finance approval; no automated listing or personalized price change.
confirmationGates.campaign: Named human approval of the rendered variant, prompt and model version.
confirmationGates.escalation: Distinct approver, reason and expiry; self-approval is denied.

responsibleDrinkingNotice: Please enjoy responsibly. Vintora does not sell to minors. Answers are guidance, not health claims.
evidenceGaps: No offline evaluation set or result is attached.
No human-reviewed model or prompt promotion record is attached.
No production retrieval, prompt or model-version log sink exists.
No licensed safety classifier or health-claim verifier is integrated.
